SELECT

Bash(powershell -Command "

\\$conn.Open\(\)

SELECT 
    t.name AS table_name,
    c.name AS column_name,
    tp.name AS data_type,
    c.max_length,
    c.precision,
    c.scale,
    c.is_nullable,
    c.is_identity,

FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.columns c ON t.object_id = c.object_id

Bash(powershell -Command "
$query = @'
SELECT 
    t.name AS table_name,
    c.name AS column_name,
    tp.name AS data_type,
    c.max_length,
    c.precision,
    c.scale,
    c.is_nullable,
    c.is_identity,
    ISNULL\(dc.definition,''\) AS default_def
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.columns c ON t.object_id = c.object_id
JOIN sys.types tp ON c.user_type_id = tp.user_type_id
LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON c.default_object_id = dc.object_id
ORDER BY t.name, c.column_id
'@
$conn = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection\('Server=172.16.6.11;Database=bmcs_db;User Id=sa;Password=Sapassword1;TrustServerCertificate=true;'\)
$conn.Open\(\)
$cmd = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlCommand\($query, $conn\)
$reader = $cmd.ExecuteReader\(\)
while \($reader.Read\(\)\) {
    $row = @\(\)
    for \($i = 0; $i -lt $reader.FieldCount; $i++\) { $row += $reader.GetValue\($i\) }
    $row -join '|'
}
$conn.Close\(\)
")
